limits: All 24,879 sectors in 68 official Freedoom 0.13.0 Phase1/Phase2 maps compare native sector-index midpoints with the two unchanged original P_GroupLines assignments compiled as C with UBSan. Independent WAD parsing supplies bounds; every official sector is nonempty and every original signed32-bit sum is defined.

The 39 lifecycle cases use native GameNew/GameLoad, WorldSpawn/WorldRemove/WorldSweep and actual DP cache loads. They cover distant and local actors, map-eight clipping, actor generation reuse, inactive actors, actor/sector/global identity, invalid origins, foreign owners, session random-state preservation and cross-level handle reuse.

GameLoad publishes the new level before reclaiming the old one. The scene only compares its old level pointer, stops old channels, then borrows the current level; it never dereferences the retired level.
Sound output uses the deterministic port boundary in this component test. No song task, focus adapter, rendering load, actual Play callback or audible browser delivery is established here.
For an empty or invalid sector, SoundOrigin rejects the source. The official maps have no empty sectors; no original undefined bounding-box or signed-overflow behavior is reproduced.
